findings.identity_and_boundary: For a<0, residual b+−b=(−b)+; for a>=0, residual=b+. Thus stated same-sign interiors and explicit a=0 ownership are exact, including zero b.
findings.opposite_slope_support: With alpha beta<0, signs coincide exactly between roots u and v; conditional continuous endpoints have zero probability. r=|beta||X−v| there, for either slope orientation. Equal roots give zero everywhere.
findings.probability: Conditional on full past-measurable H and independent fresh standard-normal X, interval probability is |Phi(u)−Phi(v)|. No Gaussian state law or coordinate independence of H is used.
findings.first_moment: Use oriented integral from v to u of (x−v)phi(x). The antiderivative −phi(x)−v Phi(x) gives phi(v)−phi(u)−v(Phi(u)−Phi(v)); derivative with respect to u is (u−v)phi(u), proving nonnegativity on either side.
findings.positive_bounds: Pointwise distance<=delta gives |beta|delta p; integrating triangular distance with phi<=1/sqrt(2pi) gives |beta|delta²/(2sqrt(2pi)). Fixed-v local limit follows density continuity.
findings.raw_state_moment: u−v=(wj/beta−wi/alpha) dot h. Tower expectation yields raw E[HH^T], including mean outer product; finite second moment suffices. Zero-state statement uses the explicitly bias-free linear offsets.
findings.downstream: The initial exact-minus-signed-surrogate difference is e_j r. Componentwise ReLU Lipschitz yields |Wh|^s e_j r for any identical future inputs and any signed initial surrogate; pair-margin coefficient is absolute row contrast times this bound.
findings.scope: Expected margin control alone is not classification control. Cost, actual pair rarity, state moments, numerical cancellation and first-index decisions remain separate prerequisites.

excluded_cases: Zero or same-sign fresh-input slopes need different conditional formulas.
Input rank/order conditioning can destroy the standard-normal fresh-input law.
Signed surrogate is not a valid nonnegative hidden state until corrected; it is only a mathematical intermediate.
Near-antipodal cosine does not bound threshold separation when slopes/offsets vary.
No claimed target pair, probability rarity, region-count reduction, operation win or ARC solution.
Naive difference of density/CDF terms is not a stable or certified numerical implementation.
